description: This file defines a Java interface named UserService which declares methods for user-related operations such as find, create, update, and delete.

methods.name: findUser
methods.description: Finds and returns a User given a user ID.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Creates a new user with the provided User object.

methods.name: updateUser
methods.description: Updates an existing user with information from the provided User object.

methods.name: deleteUser
methods.description: Deletes a user identified by the user ID.
